messages:
nina: Noticed a 2% bump in unassigned leads last night. Looks correlated with enrichment webhook timeouts.

omar: timeline? where in the pipeline does it drop to no-owner?

nina: enrichment returns 202 on intake, callback to /assign delayed >40s, RR sees no enrichment and writes owner=null.

zoe: quick mitigation: add a 30s handshake wait before fallback + mark lead as pending instead of null owner.

kai: agree. Also add a `routing_note=handshake_canary` property so SDRs know.

omar: config snippet for ops:
```
routing:
  handshake_seconds: 30
  pending_flag: true
  fallback_pool: "sdr-overflow"
  max_retries: 3
```

zoe: obs: emit `routing.handshake.latency_p95` and `routing.unassigned.rate`. Alert if rate > 1% over 15m.

nina: I'll own the HubSpot gate change so HS only calls /assign when `enrichment_status=complete` or after handshake expires. Will canary at 5%.

kai: SalesOps wants a heads-up email and a CSV export of canary leads to prevent dup outreach.

omar: create a JIRA and add a rollback plan: disable flag, revert routing.fallback to previous behavior.

ops-bot: Created TASK-4333: "handshake window canary + SalesOps export" assigned to growth-eng. Link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/TASK-4333

nina: QA cases: delayed callback 70s -> should go to fallback with routing_note; fast callback 5s -> normal assign; duplicate callbacks -> idempotent assign.

zoe: good. I'll update the playbook and add owner_history logging for audits.

kai: ping SalesOps when canary starts.
